name: Translation to Ello
label: Quest
description: In Duskwood, you carry Sirra Von'Indi's translation to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. It belongs to the Abercrombie story, and the letter bears news…
intro: In Duskwood, you carry Sirra Von'Indi's translation to Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. It belongs to the Abercrombie story, and the letter bears news of the hermit's writings.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh my! If what is written on this note is true, then Abercrombie's done something...unspeakable.
You better bring the translated note back to Ello.
And do so quickly, for I fear a doom already lumbers toward our town...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, is the note translated? Please, let me see it...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ello reads the letter...and his face goes white. He then looks at you...
Although the aid you gave Abercrombie may have been motivated from kindness, your actions have doomed our town.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
